en.name: Felix IV
en.summary: A pope installed under the authority of the Gothic king Theodoric who converted a Roman temple complex into the church of Santi Cosma e Damiano.
en.body: Felix IV owed his election in large part to the backing of Theodoric, whose intervention in choosing a pope favorable to Gothic interests marked a new degree of secular influence over the papacy. He is remembered for converting part of the ancient Roman Forum's Templum Pacis into the basilica of Santi Cosma e Damiano, adorned with an early and well-preserved apse mosaic that still survives.
